C.title: Write lessons without laundering guesses

baseline.label: Persist repeated claims and retire only the source

events.state: Runtime admits the first note because the claim was repeated; its only support is an earlier derived note.

The next session retrieves L and treats withdrawn approval as current.

trial.label: Govern admission, supersession, and descendant invalidation

events.state: Runtime denies the first unsupported note before deduplication and requests source evidence.
Source approval Q subsequently arrives. Admission validates its identity, scope, generation, and backing evidence before accepting S and L.
The same delayed summary replacement carries an obsolete expected store generation. Compare-and-swap denies it, preserving the current source-linked record.
The identical withdrawal of Q traverses Q to S to L. All dependent approval claims are excluded from current retrieval; independent T remains supported.
Logical exclusion is established. Physical purge of stored summaries and queued representations remains a separately owned pending duty; deletion completion is not claimed.
The next session receives no current approval from Q, S, or L. The approval question is unresolved and requires a new authorized source.
